changes: Restore visible Edit and Multi-device action icons and keep their action track inside the existing second-column width.
Allow Edit mode while the first column is collapsed without moving the details column.
Highlight only the Favorite star icon instead of the entire action button.
Apply native MeshCentral selected states synchronously for shared and Quick rows.
Prevent host hover transforms from resizing SIRK-owned Quick and shared surfaces while preserving native interaction colors.
Raise Quick hidden-output attention only for a new execution result and do not re-arm it on ordinary clicks, refreshes or metadata loads.
Persist General icon mode across runtime restart and prefer the freshly saved admin snapshot over a stale browser bootstrap.
Complete the pre-handoff cleanup and remove legacy compatibility layers.
Consolidate native MeshCentral theme, workspace layout, Collapse and Quick state ownership.
Use atomic module rendering and avoid intermediate Devices redraws between SIRK workspaces.
Route SIRK action history through native MeshCentral Events without standalone audit storage or a Logs tab.
Persist General icon mode through the canonical admin endpoint and keep Approval semantic colors on icons only.
Stop SIRK from styling the native Devices toolbar and Plugins tab.
Synchronize release metadata, documentation and CI with version 1.8.20 and Node.js 24.
Reset the public version history to the verified 1.8.20 handoff baseline; earlier development history remains available in Git and docs/releases.
